title: Flexible-swap reservation UX + localized billing and release notes for Dedicated
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: deliver a coordinated launch that enables customers to swap existing Dedicated reservation commitments into a new flexible-burst product offering, with localized billing language, region-specific tax/legal copy, and sequenced release notes across EMEA and JP. Scope includes product UX (console + API), billing pipeline changes, localized copy and legal signoff, release notes orchestration, sales/partner enablement materials, and migration tooling for conversions. Success metrics: <1% billing disputes in first 60 days, >75% sales enablement readiness score, migration tool completes bulk swaps with <2% manual intervention, release notes live in 95% of target locales within 48h of launch.
acceptance_criteria: Console swap flow implemented and validated in staging with mock ledger entries
Billing pipeline emits new invoice line items for flexible-burst SKUs and mapback to original reservation IDs
Localized release notes pages created for en-US, en-GB, fr-FR, de-DE, nl-NL, ja-JP and approved by legal/local compliance
Migration CLI supports dry-run, rollback, and idempotent retries with audit logs
Sales enablement deck and partner API changelog published and acknowledged by top 10 resellers
